remarks: Charming One-Bedroom Apartment in Convenient Location  Welcome home to this lovely, freshly painted one-bedroom apartment offering comfort, convenience, and charm. The apartment features beautiful wood floors, a spacious kitchen, and an in-unit washer and dryer for added convenience.  Ideally located within walking distance to town, shopping, restaurants, and the train station, this apartment is an excellent choice for commuters and those who enjoy having everything close by.  Additional amenities include a private driveway and a detached storage shed, providing extra space for your belongings. The water bill is the only shared utility and is split with Unit 172.  A wonderful opportunity to enjoy comfortable living in a convenient location-come see all this inviting apartment has to offer!
